brief: Lamson Digital is an IT outsourcing and business process outsourcing company founded in Ho Chi Minh City in 2008, with a second delivery center in Da Nang and a sales office in Denver, United States. 18 years in operation, 260 engineers and specialists, 340 projects delivered, 98% client satisfaction. Certified ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015, appraised at CMMI Level 3. Software services: custom software development, web and mobile apps, QA and test automation, DevOps and cloud migration, data engineering and analytics, legacy system maintenance, AI chatbot development, dedicated development teams. Back-office services: bookkeeping and reconciliation, payroll processing. AI work: support assistants, voice assistants, invoice document reading, discovery workshops, workflow builds, monthly run and improve reports. Clients: product companies and enterprises in healthcare, finance, retail and education; US CPA and accounting firms (white-label bookkeeping, payroll and tax preparation support, full-time equivalent staff). Case studies: Brightpath Health, healthcare supply chain platform, 15% lower annual supply spend, 70-person team; Summit Ledger CPA, accounting, took over bookkeeping for 120 small business clients, month-end close in 6 days, 99.5% reconciliation accuracy; Coastline Learning, education, rebuilt a learning platform for 40,000 students, 3x faster page loads, 0 hours of downtime at launch. Reviews: Grace Holloway, VP of Technology at Brightpath Health: "Lamson Digital gave us a team that knows healthcare data and ships every sprint. Two years in, we still add people to it." Mark Ellison, Managing Partner at Summit Ledger CPA: "Our busy season used to mean late nights for everyone. The Lamson Digital bookkeepers now close our client books on time, every month." Thao Nguyen, Product Director at Coastline Learning: "They rebuilt our platform in eight months and the launch went without a single hour of downtime." Awards: Clutch Top IT Services Company Vietnam 2025, GoodFirms Top Software Developers 2025, VINASA Sao Khue Award 2024. Rated 4.9 out of 5 on Clutch from 38 reviews. Offices: 6th Floor, 45 Le Duan Street, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, phone (+84) 28 5555 0145; 1600 Stout Street, Suite 1200, Denver, CO 80202, phone (+1) 303 555 0188. Email hello@lamsondigital.example.
